description: The ONE write path for duplicate_of (D5/N3): a duplicate becomes real only from a person-named confirmer; a machine confirmer (agent/model/loop/tool) is refused by name. The detector (suggest-duplicates) never writes — it only suggests. After the confirmation, `duplicateOf` is set to the other bug's id. The result is the row as it now stands. A confirmation is a human act, the same kind of gate S24's policy-authorship check draws.
